name: Boon of the Founder's Oath
text: The town itself answers this hero's call.

benefits.text: Once per season, can call every hero and militiaman home to defend the town, and they all arrive at once.

name: Boon of the Unfading Map
text: Wherever this hero has walked stays known.

benefits.text: Regions this hero has explored never fall back into fog, and the town sees large threats there live.

name: Bounty Hunter
text: Takes posted bounties over open adventuring and is quicker to finish them.

benefits.text: Bounties claimed by this hero pay a tenth more, and marked targets cannot hide from them under fog.

name: Cult Hunter
text: Knows the smell of incense in the wrong cellar.

benefits.text: Deals extra damage to cultists and has a chance each week to unmask an agent on the council.

name: Fog Sense
text: An instinct for what waits in the mist.

benefits.text: Parties with this hero are never surprised in fogged regions, and their reports of unseen threats are more accurate.

name: Plague Doctor
text: Beak mask, vinegar sponge and steady hands.

benefits.text: Treats disease in the field, halving the time villagers stay sick, and resists catching it.

name: Reagent Forager
text: Always has an eye on the ground for something the alchemists want.

benefits.text: Returns from expeditions with a handful of common reagents, and sometimes a rare one.

name: Siege Engineer
text: Can build, aim or wreck the engines of war.

benefits.text: Ballistas and catapults they crew fire faster, and enemy engines they reach burn.

name: Spell Courier
text: Has learned to stretch a spell slot into a message home.

benefits.text: Sends longer, clearer spell-slot messages to town and can send one more per expedition.

name: Tavern Regular
text: Everyone at the bar knows this hero's name.

benefits.text: Hears rumors first and recovers from bad moods in one night at the tavern.

name: Town Hero
prerequisite: Saved the town in a siege
text: Songs are sung about this hero.

benefits.text: While in town, raises the renown of every hero who adventures with them, and recruits come from further away.

name: Trade-Road Savvy
text: Grew up beside the wagons and knows the price of everything.

benefits.text: Sells loot for more in town and haggles caravan escort bounties upward.

name: Wall Fighter
text: Trained to fight from battlements and towers.

benefits.text: Deals more damage to climbers and attackers below, and is hard to knock off a wall.
